pages.title: Les Fleurs du Mal
pages.text: Wither Rose · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Wither Rose Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)Some flowers bloom more brightly on graves than in gardens.$(br2)— Charles Baudelaire, Les Fleurs du Mal

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: Nearby beings wither within 7 blocks; you are immune.$(br2)$(br2)Withering Aura 3:00, Wither 0:02
